The '''Ciutric Offensive''' was a campaign launched by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], to [[Reconquest of the Rim|drive out]] [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] from the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]] and the surrounding regions.

==Prelude==
After the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Separatist forces that had fled from the defeats at [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] crossed the [[Void of Chopani/Legends|Void of Chopani]] and joined forces with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]] in the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]]. Based out of [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed's]] fleet formed part of [[Tenth Army|Crimson Dagger Command]], which was charged with eliminating this threat.<ref name="EGtW" />

==The campaign==
Screed's forces defeated the Separatists early at the [[Battle of Vinsoth (Imperial Period)|Battle of Vinsoth]] and the Muun leadership fled to [[Binquaros]]. There, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi's]] ground forces began a [[Siege of Binquaros|celebrated siege]], while Screed continued his pursuit of the combined Separatist and Thalassian fleet ships to [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]].<ref name="EGtW" />

Concurrently, a second Imperial task force moved up the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] against [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces, winning engagements at [[Engagement at Fenion|Fenion]], [[Engagement at Phindar|Phindar]] and [[Engagement at Sheris|Sheris]].<ref name="EGtW" />

Screed eliminated the Separatist fleet at the [[Battle of Bimmiel]], but while he was engaged there, the pirate and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces driven from the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] overcame his rearguard at [[Botajef system/Legends|Botajef]]. Joining forces with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] from [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], they broke Romodi's siege at Binquaros and fled down the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] with their allies, hoping to escape to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Acting on intelligence from a pirate captain, Screed and Romodi rejoined forces and intercepted the Separatists at the [[Vardoss system/Legends|Vardoss system]], where they finally defeated them at the [[Assault on Vardoss IV]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Aftermath==
After this campaign, Screed and Romodi's victory saw them celebrated as heroes in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Having made their reputation in the campaign, they would receive command of naval and ground forces during the [[Western Reaches Operation]] two years later.<ref name="EGtW" />
